description: Version commission, payment fees and variable COGS used in profit decisions.

assumptions.description: Optional JSON object stored with this cost version. Its profit_threshold, a number, is the break-even bar: AttriKit suggests scale only when the low return per 1 unit of spend exceeds it (1.00 is true break-even). The API stores {} when omitted.

effective_at.description: When this cost version takes effect: a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO 8601 date-time.

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry key for this exact mutation.

payment_fee_bps.description: Payment fees outside the store commission, in basis points, 0-10,000. Usually 0 for App Store revenue.

store_commission_bps.description: Store commission in basis points, 0-10,000: 1,500 is 15% (Apple's Small Business Program), 3,000 is 30%.

variable_cogs_kind.description: How variable_cogs_value is read: bps is a percent of revenue in basis points; per_unit_minor is a fixed amount per install in the currency's minor units.

variable_cogs_value.description: The other variable cost, a whole number: basis points of revenue, at most 10,000, for bps; minor units per install for per_unit_minor.

name: set_cost_model
title: Set an app cost model
